podcast.body: The lead single from The Brothers Johnson's debut LP *Look Out for Number One*. This strutting bop, produced by Quincy Jones, topped the R&B chart and reached number three on the Hot 100 in the summer of 1976, showcasing their polished funky sound. "I'll be good to you topped the R&B chart and reached number three on the hot 100 in the summer of 1976."
